baseline.rule: Do not repeat or discard completed Night Shift research, implementation, qualification, or reconciliation. New work must be an evidence-backed delta on top of that baseline.

research_delta.title: Am I More Pointwise or Pairwise? Revealing Position Bias in Rubric-Based LLM-as-a-Judge
research_delta.finding: Rubric-based LLM judges show systematic score-option position bias; balanced permutation of rubric order can expose and reduce that bias and improve human correlation.
research_delta.system_implication: Add rubric-order permutation invariance as an explicit evaluator robustness gate rather than assuming a stable rubric yields order-invariant judgments.

research_delta.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge: Concerning Rubric Artifacts in LLM-based Automated Text Generation Evaluation
research_delta.finding: Judge outputs can be partly predicted from rubric wording alone, and counterfactual response/rubric reversals may not reliably change judgments.
research_delta.system_implication: Add rubric-only leakage and counterfactual sensitivity checks so evaluator confidence cannot be inferred from rubric artifacts instead of passage evidence.

research_delta.title: LitVISTA: A Benchmark for Narrative Orchestration in Literary Text
research_delta.finding: Narrative-function/structure integration remains difficult and end-to-end failures are dominated by anchor identification/localization.
research_delta.system_implication: Keep anchor localization separately scored and do not infer global narrative-function accuracy from fluent analysis.

research_delta.title: LitBench: A Benchmark and Dataset for Reliable Evaluation of Creative Writing
research_delta.finding: Specialized reward models outperform off-the-shelf zero-shot judges but still do not eliminate disagreement with human literary preference.
research_delta.system_implication: Automated evaluator output remains evidence, not author authority; retain abstention, calibration, and human/author boundaries.

research_delta.title: Style over Story: Measuring LLM Narrative Preferences via Structured Selection
research_delta.finding: Models show stable preference for style over event, character, and setting content dimensions.
research_delta.system_implication: Add or verify style-vs-story-function decoupling tests so surface style cannot dominate preservation, event, character, or narrative-function evidence.

research_delta.title: Literary Evidence Retrieval via Long-Context Language Models
research_delta.finding: Whole-work literary evidence retrieval requires both global narrative reasoning and close textual localization.
research_delta.system_implication: Long-form qualification should explicitly connect macro interpretation to exact textual evidence rather than score either layer alone.

dedupe_first_implementation_targets.action: Inspect existing evaluator robustness fixtures for rubric-score order permutation coverage. If absent, implement balanced-permutation tests and a fail-closed variance threshold without touching the six blind ground-truth cases.
dedupe_first_implementation_targets.completion_delta: Prove that material evaluator dispositions are not artifacts of rubric option ordering, or expose the exact instability for repair.

dedupe_first_implementation_targets.action: Inspect for rubric-only prediction leakage and response/rubric counterfactual sensitivity coverage. If absent, add fixtures that require judgments to move when passage evidence is materially reversed while forbidding passage-free confidence claims.
dedupe_first_implementation_targets.completion_delta: Detect evaluator conclusions driven by rubric artifacts rather than evidence.

dedupe_first_implementation_targets.action: Verify whether current extraction qualification separately measures anchor existence, anchor localization, and narrative function. Implement only missing metric/test layers.
dedupe_first_implementation_targets.completion_delta: Prevent fluent global analysis from masking anchor-localization failure.

dedupe_first_implementation_targets.action: Verify existing role-blind/style-bias coverage. Add only missing paired fixtures where surface polish conflicts with event/character/function preservation.
dedupe_first_implementation_targets.completion_delta: Prove evaluator preservation decisions do not collapse into style preference.

dedupe_first_implementation_targets.action: Map current long-form tests against macro interpretation plus exact evidence localization and middle-book factual/temporal slices; implement only uncovered support fixtures.
dedupe_first_implementation_targets.completion_delta: Create a tomorrow-ready map for long-form literary evidence qualification without pretending short-passage success proves whole-book accuracy.

blindness_boundary.rule: No research-support implementation may read, score, tune against, reproduce predictions for, or change the six blind cases or their author labels before the isolated prediction seal. Generic evaluator robustness work must use independent fixtures only.

second_shift_recommendation: Resume the pending P4 Prose completion census and execute dedupe-first evaluator robustness preparation using independent fixtures. Preserve all completed Night Shift work; do not rerun it merely because its old delegation binding became stale.
tomorrow_ready_output: A reconciled Prose completion/evidence map plus tested non-blind evaluator robustness deltas, with exact uncovered gaps and one dependency-valid implementation successor ready for day shift.
